source.title: Choose the review route for a purchase request
source.license: Illustrative policy for this tutorial; not an organization policy.
source.author: Helixor documentation

paragraphs.text: If the supplier is not approved, route the request to supplier review.
For an approved supplier, an amount above 5000 USD without manager approval goes to manager review.
Otherwise route the request to the standard purchasing process. Routing is not permission to place an order or pay.
Purchase amount, approved-supplier status and manager-approval status must all be supplied as typed facts. Missing information blocks this check.
